    Exception hierarchy for HDF5 wrapper operations.
    Hdf5Errors.AttributeException
    Raised when an attribute create / read / write / delete call fails on a group or dataset.
    Hdf5Errors.DatasetCreateException
    Raised when dataset creation fails — type setup, dataspace setup, or the H5Dcreate2 call itself.
    Hdf5Errors.DatasetOpenException
    Raised when H5Dopen2 returns a negative dataset id.
    Hdf5Errors.DatasetReadException
    Raised when H5Dread (or any of its split-read variants) reports failure.
    Hdf5Errors.DatasetWriteException
    Raised when H5Dwrite (or any of its split-write variants) reports failure.
    Hdf5Errors.FileCreateException
    Raised when H5Fcreate returns a negative file id, typically due to permissions or a missing parent directory.
    Hdf5Errors.FileNotFoundException
    Raised when an HDF5 file path is requested but the file does not exist on disk.
    Hdf5Errors.FileOpenException
    Raised when H5Fopen returns a negative file id, typically due to a corrupt header or a non-HDF5 file.
    Hdf5Errors.GroupCreateException
    Raised when H5Gcreate2 returns a negative group id.
    Hdf5Errors.GroupOpenException
    Raised when H5Gopen2 returns a negative group id.
    Hdf5Errors.Hdf5Exception
    Base unchecked exception for any failure raised by the HDF5 wrapper layer.
    Hdf5Errors.OutOfRangeException
    Raised when a hyperslab request extends past the dataset extent.
